title: audit conditional rank8 ratio and gluing lemmas
head: 7a1309f18f56d04c2db33bf1607e0332d19f72b3
body:
PR1212 Lemmas 5-6 underpin later rank-8 puncture results, but their nonzero ratio classification and global gluing still had an explicit independent-audit handoff. This package corroborates those two conditional lemmas with an expanded proof and a separate exact checker. It adds polynomial/unimodular certificates retaining the local sign torsion, a symbolic ordinary-transpose calculation, independently reconstructed P112/P120 geometry, and integer retractions certifying saturated global gluing. No substantive flaw was found; zero exclusion remains an inherited premise.

- Scope/coordination: [claim1448](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1448), [requested audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18912316). TASK records the explicit change from the complex-masked-decoder card. Original main pin410026 is retained; branch starts from refreshed main ef5f3940, with unchanged guidance/selection. Fresh complete overlap covered745 open PRs and174 Discussion records with no competing scope.
- Verification: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank8-ratio-gluing-audit` passed under Python3.12.14, with28 exact named checks. Normal and optimized direct replays passed; optional certificate export was byte-identical across research/local runs (hash inREADME), and a mutated saved certificate failed under `-O`. The1MB generated witness is regenerated on demand rather than committed. `git diff --check` passed.
- Additional evidence: original PR1212 checker separately passed61 P112/41 P120 checks. A separate Pro chat corroborated the displayed universal algebra only and supplied two incorporated prose clarifications; it did not inspect this checker or its geometry. Its6 groups of identity checks passed local normal/optimized replay.
- Limits: no independent zero-exclusion DRUP, arbitrary-pivot symmetry transport, later punctures, cost/hosting/physical supplier, selected-frontier change, new kappa, full multiplication theorem or formal/human review. Open next question: proof-assistant verification of the integer-retraction-to-monomial bridge.

Credit: Brett Halligan/@burntout76 and Ninefold (PR1212 at57099cb5684f38877f31d149d598801671a633db), DreamingOfClouds (PR717), themilkman216 (PR968). Prepared by Andrey Mas with substantial GPT-6 Pro research through ChatGPT and Codex coordination, packaging and local replay. Apache-2.0. Exact source pins, test boundaries and attribution are in the package.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
